task_description: Write a method in Dafny to perform index wise multiplication of elements in the given two sequences.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SequenceWiseMultiplication(seq1: seq<int>, seq2: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the result sequence should be equal to the length of the input sequences
    - For each index i within the bounds of the sequences, result[i] should be equal to seq1[i] * seq2[i]
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.  
In this case:  
    method ElementWiseMultiply(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)  
  
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.  
In this case:  
Natural language description:  
    - Both sequences should be non-null  
    - Both sequences should have the same length  
  
Dafny specification:  
    requires a != null && b != null  
    requires |a| == |b|  
  
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.  
In this case:  
Natural language description:  
    - The length of the result sequence should be the same as the input sequences  
    - Each element in the result sequence should be the product of the corresponding elements in the input sequences  
  
Dafny specification:  
    ensures result != null  
    ensures |result| == |a|  
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |a| ==> result[i] == a[i] * b[i]  
  
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.  
In this case:

```dafny
method ElementWiseMultiply(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires a != null && b != null
    requires |a| == |b|
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |a|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |a| ==> result[i] == a[i] * b[i]
{
    result := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < |a|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |a|
        invariant |result| == i
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> result[k] == a[k] * b[k]
    {
        result := result + [a[i] * b[i]];
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
